description: This file defines API endpoints for managing 'highlights' in a sports live-stream platform backend. It uses FastAPI to set up routes for retrieving highlight lists, details, and featured highlights. The code includes route handlers, utilizes dependencies for database sessions, and interacts with repository and schema modules to fetch and serialize data.

methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a paginated list of highlights, allowing optional filtering by match ID.
